info.title: Explore Mozambique API
info.description:
REST API to discover and manage tourist, cultural, historical, natural and recreational places in Mozambique. Two collections (places, reviews) with full CRUD, server-side validation, MongoDB persistence and authentication.

**Authentication (OAuth + local accounts).** GET endpoints are public. POST, PUT and DELETE on /places and /reviews, and GET /auth/profile, are **protected**: they return 401 until you log in.

**How to log in:**
1. GitHub OAuth: open `/auth/github` in the browser address bar (it redirects to GitHub and back to this page), or
2. Local account: run `POST /auth/register`, then `POST /auth/login` here in Swagger.

A session cookie is stored by the browser and sent automatically on the following requests. Check it with `GET /auth/status`. Log out with `POST /auth/logout`.
